notes: 1536 seeded nonuniform-grid samples at three scales match independently materialized exhaustive triangle barycentric/plane queries. Flat/tilted/steep surfaces, checkerboard diagonals, shared grid edges/vertices, holes, closed outer boundaries and range failures have Cargo-native cases.

8192 retained 65x65 queries allocate/reallocate zero times, test one cell/triangle and reuse one prepared normal, with at most16 coordinate comparisons. Preparation and vector-payload retained bytes are reported independently; no timing speedup is claimed.

Developer-facing complete prepared sample calls run in the existing Divan primitive3 benchmark. This is vertical surface projection, not a ray, capsule sweep, rigid-body contact or character response.
benchmark: Complete prepared sample calls use the existing Divan primitive3 suite; no new Criterion suite is added.

Convex polytope (box, wedge) overlap with the surface by the separating-axis test (face normals and edge cross products per triangle under the footprint, deepest triangle kept): closed-form depths on flat terrain, and 400 seeded oriented boxes on hills against a sampled reference (straddling boxes overlap, boxes clear of the sampled surface do not).

Capsule contact skips the exact distance test for triangles whose plane the segment clears by more than radius + margin + 1e-9 * (1 + scale) on one side; a seeded differential fuzz (heightfield_differential_tests.rs: 60000 queries over random nonuniform terrains with holes, both diagonals and offsets to 3e4, tangent/grazing face, edge and vertex placements at the pruning boundary) requires bit-identical contacts against the unpruned kernel. The Divan heightfield bench times capsule contact and sweep for character capsules on rolling terrain.

Capsule sweep searches triangles best-first by a lower bound on their touch (Newton time raised to a plane bound) and stops at the best hit; a seeded differential fuzz (40000 sweeps, grazing and near-tangent displacements, 0..64 iterations) against the id-order kernel requires bit-identical Ok results, Err only where the old kernel failed, and every Err that became Ok to match the old kernel with 2^20 iterations. A work ratchet holds the rolling-terrain triangle tests below 75/60/85/72% of the old kernel (walk/fall/skim/fast diagonal).
